verdictReason: The gap is real and unbuilt, so the item stands, but its placement is partly off (inference-core filter) and it omits the existing org-core entitlement and org_quota pull infrastructure that should be reused.

exactGap: Tool risk is judged by two undeclared mechanisms: execution-core matches name substrings and treats every mcp__ name as risky (permission/mod.rs:195-293), and capability-core rows carry only a 3-level risk_level that EvaluatePolicy consumes (models/capability.go:23-37; policy/engine.go:112-152), with no per-tool side-effect class. MCP tools are offered to Do runs but trusted_capability_id is a static map that returns None for them (capability_policy.rs:741-840), so execute_step_inner refuses every call before dispatch (runtime_loop/mod.rs:502; capability_policy.rs:361-362), and the inline Ask path refuses them by design (tool_loop.rs:625-642). The MCP annotation classifier McpToolAnnotations::side_effect exists with no production consumer (mcp_jsonrpc.rs:65-125), the static never-auto set is only tickets.create (permission/mod.rs:72-79), and there is no per-tool allow/ask/never store (hooks are an in-memory registry written only by gRPC RegisterHook).

constraints: Model Plane owns capabilities, so declared classes and MCP tool rows must be registry-owned in capability-core and bound server-side; the binding may never be synthesised from a model-supplied name (capability_policy.rs:836-838), and trusted_capability_id is a synchronous static map today, so dynamic rows need an async registry lookup in execution-core. The code states that two risk tables would diverge (permission/mod.rs:81-92), so the declared class must replace is_risky_call as the input to rung_required_for rather than sit beside it. The inline loop has no continuation contract and the code says a gateway proxy for Ask would be an authority bypass until one exists (tool_loop.rs:625-638), so Ask-mode MCP reads are a later, separate contract. ZDR must propagate: ZDR turns run no inline tool loop (zdr_features.rs:150-185) and agentic runs carry zdr (execution.proto:100-107), so MCP servers outside the attestation boundary must be refused there. Hooks are an in-memory registry in model-gateway (state.rs:317, runtime_registries.rs:2003) with no gateway or SPA write path found, so they are not a policy store.
approachAdjustment: Reuse capability-core risk_level and the rung ladder: add a side_effect_class (or map risk_level plus annotations) on the capability row, derive MCP tool rows at discovery as children of the mcp_server row with a digest, make trusted_capability_id resolve dynamic mcp__server__tool names through the registry, and have rung_required_for and the permission engine read the class. Deliver Do-mode first; treat "read-only in Ask" as a follow-on that needs the inline continuation contract. Store per-tool allow/ask/never in capability-core (durable, user and org scope), not in the hook registry.
effortNote: L holds for Do mode (registry rows, async binding, class-driven rung mapping, policy store, forged-call test). Adding Ask-mode MCP reads would push it toward XL and should be split out.
verdictReason: The central claim is confirmed (MCP tools are offered but always refused, risk is name-guessed), but the item should build on the existing risk_level, rung ladder and McpSideEffect type, correct "unknown defaults" wording against those, and separate Ask-mode MCP into a later step.

approachAdjustment: The item's "signed with the session or run decision" is heavier than the codebase needs: use the BFF-stamp pattern for chat turns and a service-principal pull (org_quota.rs pattern) for Dreaming and learning review, or make session-core user_memory_controls the single enforcement copy written through a gateway route when the user toggles, keeping user-core AISettings.memoryEnabled as a mirror or retiring it so there are not two switches. effortNote: M for a user-level on/paused/off switch plus Reset (session-core state column, Dreaming and recall gates, gateway route, MemorySection controls). Org policy, learning-review gating and the Ask-mode remember path make the full item L.
verdictReason: Gap is accurate and verified (no switch, no reset, no org policy, stored flag unread), so the recommendation stands; the approach should reuse the BFF-stamp and org_quota pull patterns, and effort is larger than M once org policy and learning review are included.
